comparison.objective: Open a beverage can using its recessed stay-on tab; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinch and lift a low-profile tab until the scored seal breaks versus hex-bit insertion, bounded torque, fine collar adjustment, and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Can seal opened with tab appropriately actuated versus two safe repeatable carriage stops and a locked, stable setting.
comparison.reason: Both require small-feature manipulation, but the candidate additionally tests adjustable damping under dynamic load.
